The '''Dark Riders''' was a unit of [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commandos]] led by famed [[Scout trooper/Legends|speeder bike scout]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Irlyn Resk]] and stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend VI]].<ref name="S&V" />

==History==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Stend VI]] was at first glance a standard [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-allied world within the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The world had neither extreme weather nor dangerous creatures and was notably peaceful compared to others, leading to a dull life for those of the populace seeking adventure and excitement. The boredom of Stend VI to this portion of its inhabitants led to the formation of some of the most dangerous [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]-riding thugs with wanton disregard for the law, property, and often life. Their bikes modified with heavy weaponry, enhanced acceleration boosters, and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] boosters, these airborne pirates had become a problem for the Empire, especially on Stend VI. The [[Stend VI Security Forces]] had been outmatched for some time by the planet's swoop gangs, but nonetheless made an attempt to curb their activities with the Forces' favored [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Ando]] [[22-B Nightfalcon]] and [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. Regardless, the local law enforcement agencies simply didn't have the trained pilots or vehicles necessary to combat the high-speed criminals.<ref name="S&V" />

Responding to a request for assistance, the Empire deployed a wing of heavily armored [[64-Y Swift 3 Repulsorlift Sled|repulsorlift sleds]] to the planet. While they made an apparent impact early on, Imperial commanders on Stend VI were eventually disappointed by the results as they were soon overwhelmed by the sheer number of gangs and their modified bikes. To end the gangs once and for all the commanders received approval to form a new military unit designed specifically to eliminate the threat. This led to the creation of the Dark Riders, a squad of elite [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commandos]] that utilized heavily modified [[XR-10 Shadowhawk]] speeder bikes equipped with both passive [[Sound dampener/Legends|sound dampeners]] and [[Baffler/Legends|sensor bafflers]]. Led by famed [[Scout trooper/Legends|speeder bike scout]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Irlyn Resk]], the unit was believed to be more than a match for the planet's swoop gangs.<ref name="S&V" />

Resk was  a typical Imperial officer in most respects, meaning he hated aliens, genuinely believed in the ideals of the Emperor, and was little more than a cruel thug. Despite this, the Dark Riders' commander had his own agenda. Aside from wishing to eliminate the swoop gangs for good, Resk wanted to connect legendary retired racer [[Blizz Pinnix]] and their bar/museum [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]] to the swoop gangs in order to confiscate anything he wanted, especially Pinnix's infamous swoop ''[[Black Raptor]]''.<ref name="S&V" />
